category.description: The general type of incident being reported
category.clarification_question: What type of incident is this?

severity.description: How serious the incident is, based on wording and consequences described

location.description: Where on site the incident occurred, as stated in the transcript
location.clarification_question: Where on site did this happen?

description.description: A short factual summary of what happened, staying close to the transcript's own wording
description.clarification_question: Can you briefly describe what happened?

action_needed.description: What the speaker says should happen next, if stated

emergency.description: Whether this requires immediate emergency attention — life-threatening danger, serious injury, active fire/collapse/electrocution risk — not just any incident, however serious-sounding
emergency.clarification_question: Is this an emergency requiring immediate attention right now?

reporter_name.description: Name of the person reporting the incident. Collected only to prevent false emergency alarms before notifying management — never inferred from the transcript, always asked directly.
reporter_name.clarification_question: What is your name, in case we need to follow up right away?
